Author: Jacob5800
Name: Retainer Pricer
Description: Price eligible retainer listings with live marketboard or Universalis data and a configurable match or one-gil-undercut rule. Manage retainer ventures using the game's own retainer UI.
Punchline: Price listings and manage retainer ventures.
Changelog:
## 0.5.1.99

- The multi-character Start button is now **Run multi char sequence**, and also appears at the top beside Retainer sales while multi-character runs are enabled.
- **Start batch selling only** at the top is now hidden when Show Batch selling is turned off.
